claims.quote: Parosphromenus quindecim is a liquorice gourami known only from the Pawan and Liong river basins in West Kalimantan, Indonesian Borneo.
Known only from the Pawan and Liong river basins in southeastern West Kalimantan (Kalimantan Barat) province, Indonesia (Borneo) with the full extent of its range somewhat unclear.
